text: men of understanding: Heb. men of heart
the whole: Heb. all of it
the mighty shall be taken: Heb. they shall take away the mighty
without number: Heb. without searching out
in the open sight of others: Heb. in the place of beholders
from him: Heb. from after him
Should it be according to thy mind? Heb. Should it be from with thee?
My desire is that Job may be tried: Or, My father, let Job be tried
